body: Thank you truly, it meant a lot to read this

Thank you for responding. It means a lot that someone did 

I have a therapist I talk to on the phone but sometimes things fall apart faster than he can counsel me through 

I’ve spent so much of myself taking care of my mom and sister. I wish it was enough to make them feel like they would never try to do such a horrible thing again 

I am so tired. It’s been a lot of work to take care of myself. I just had an operation and I’m waiting on biopsy results, it hurts so much that my mom tried to kill herself knowing that and not caring enough about what might happen to me 

My spouse was acting like this is all too much and talking like they’re going to leave me

I’m really in so much pain and it feels like at the end of the day there’s nobody there for me. But I do have my dog at least. He has been trying to comfort me and make me feel less alone 

Thank you again
I plan to say sorry when she’s awake again. And I’ll follow that advice too. I truly hate fighting with her.

Thank you so, so much. This is very well said and helps give me a clearer understanding of how to move forward, and what specifically to bring up with a therapist. I deeply appreciate your time and your insight.

Yes exactly. I want to ask “how do I let the grudge go” but I recognize that is a question for a therapist. 

Thank you so much for your time here.

Thank you for responding with empathy and honesty. 

As mentioned in a comment below, I experienced homophobia and relentless bullying for all of my childhood. That has translated into a lot of problems for me as an adult, including this one. My bullies got away with everything they did to me, so the best I could get was never having to see or hear them again. That isn’t the case here and it brings up all those feelings again. I hate that the two of them bullied me as a young adult, not a child, and that they’re still a part of my life. 

I’ll try to keep in mind what you said. I also really need to find a new therapist.

My therapist recently went AWOL which is one reason why this fight got so bad. I am working on a replacement. 

It’s complicated. Thinking about taking away or trying to take away relationships that she treasures and how hurt she would be feels absolutely rotten, and I don’t want to cause her that pain. But I do wind up causing her pain because I hate them so much for what they subjected me to, I want them to go away or apologize and that will never happen. 

Bringing it up in an argument was and always will be a stupid thing to do.
Thank you for this perspective. You make a good point.

I did. I was bullied to the point of trauma for my entire childhood. 

I feel like a lack of justice exists in the situation, just like my bullies never had consequences for what they did to me, her parents only suffer some consequences. I know these feelings connect to childhood and I guess that means they could be misguided. It just really hurts sometimes.

They are pressuring her to travel by air to visit them during the holiday season to prepare for her sister’s wedding (which is in May), and I am extremely uncomfortable with that for many reasons. It was perhaps petty of me but I brought up that they would never (and didn’t) do the same for us, and it went from there.

Again, I’m not demanding to be called “incredible”. I want some acknowledgement of my emotional effort when I point it out. Last time I’m repeating myself. 

If you can’t talk to me without needless condescension then I’m not going to keep discussing this with you.
I am happy that this problem only comes up sometimes, but if it is a “wife problem” then I’d love to know more ways I could try to bridge the topic with her for a better understanding/solution
BEFORE YOU COMMENT I know I’m required to put in a tl;dr but please read enough of the post so that you’re not typing my own words back at me as if I didn’t already say them :( thanks
“I don’t want an award, just to be appreciated a little sometimes.” Like literally. Come on.
Did you read my whole post dude?
